final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS n FROM station_counts), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / n AS share FROM station_counts CROSS JOIN total WHERE n IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(telescope_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - value) FROM shares CROSS JOIN mean_share WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND share > value
